//: W3: the dead who guard the district police headquarters and the army posts (mapgen/police_army/).  Their uniforms are Saigon's (content bible §10); their death drops are in itemgroups/police_army.json and are the only zombie drops that may hold a firearm, rarely.  None of them upgrades: dda's soldier and police upgrade lines end in American specialists.  All are GEN_DORMANT, so pseudo_dormant_<id> exists for the ones lying still in the barracks and the cells.
description: A dead officer of the district công an in a khaki-yellow uniform with red collar tabs, the peaked cap gone and a pistol belt still buckled at the waist.  It moves with a heavy, deliberate tread, as if it were still walking the corridors of the headquarters.

A dead officer of the riot unit in a dark blue uniform under a soft armour vest, a scratched riot helmet strapped under its chin.  The visor is down and fogged from the inside.  Blows skid off the helmet and the vest; aim for the legs or the throat.

A dead conscript of the guard post in an olive-green uniform and canvas boots, the nón cối pith helmet hanging down its back on its strap.  It wears no armour; the army of 2004 issued none to a sentry.  It is young, fit and fast, and it still holds itself like someone on parade.
